subject: Countries and population
title: Most Populated Countries
subtitle: UN estimates, 2024
caption: The five most populated countries on Earth. Two of them are home to more than a billion people each.

items.name: Pakistan
items.fact: Pakistan is the fifth most populated country and has one of the youngest populations of any large nation.

items.name: Indonesia
items.fact: Indonesia is the largest island country in the world and the most populated Muslim-majority nation.

items.name: United States
items.fact: The United States is the only country outside Asia in the top four.

items.name: China
items.fact: China's population has started to shrink after decades of growth.

items.name: India
items.fact: India overtook China as the most populated country in 2023.
